knownGood.database: none (production runs without cloud accounts today)

tiers.trigger: Light Court renders wrong on the domain but gameplay is fine
tiers.action: Vercel -> Deployments -> Promote the previous production deployment (instant, no data change). Or revert the RC commit on main and let Git-integration redeploy.

tiers.trigger: one subsystem misbehaves (challenges, leaderboard, narrative, chaos)
tiers.action: Set the flag to false in Production env and redeploy env only: CHALLENGES_ENABLED, PUBLIC_LEADERBOARD_ENABLED, AI_NARRATIVE_ENABLED, CHAOS_CLASH_ENABLED, or CLOUD_ACCOUNTS_ENABLED=false to return to the guest-only product. MAINTENANCE_MODE=true stops all mutations while reads continue.

Promote main@9cd95ff (or its Vercel deployment) to production. Unset CLOUD_ACCOUNTS_ENABLED. The production Supabase project may be left in place (dormant) or paused; do NOT drop it while any real user has signed in — export first.
tiers.dataImpact: accounts created after promotion become unreachable from the app until re-enabled; nothing is deleted

tiers.trigger: a migration proves defective in production
tiers.action: Migrations 0001..0007 are forward-only (no down scripts are shipped). Rollback is Tier C (app off the database) plus a targeted corrective migration reviewed like a phase. Never edit an applied migration file.

clientCache: The service worker cache identity is build-derived with skipWaiting; a rolled-back deployment is picked up on the next load. Network-first HTML means no manual purge.
dns: No DNS change is part of this release or its rollback; www.eraclashbasketball.com stays pointed at the Vercel project.
